# Population pharmacokinetics of aciclovir and its major metabolite 9-carboxymethoxymethylguanine and safety profile of valaciclovir in early liver transplant recipients (Kably B, Briard M, Francoz C, Roux O, Houhou N, Mackiewicz V, Peytavin G, Durand F, Le MP, J Antimicrob Chemother 2025)

Reference: doi:10.1093/jac/dkaf070 (J Antimicrob Chemother 2025;80(5):1302-1308; Table 2 and Supplementary data, Figures S1-S5).

**Model type: parametric population pharmacokinetic model** (joint parent-metabolite nonlinear mixed-effects model, SAEM, Monolix 2023R1). Suitable for simulation and MAP Bayesian estimation (aciclovir and 9-CMMG). Caution: the parent-metabolite structure is not described in the article and was reconstructed (meaning of Kp, volume of 9-CMMG); it reproduces the published simulations (Tables 3-5) within about 15% (see Notes).

## Notes

- Study: retrospective monocentric study, 50 adult liver transplant recipients (29 men, 21 women) in the early post-operative period (median 19 days), oral valaciclovir CMV prophylaxis 1-6 g/day (mostly 2000 mg every 8 or 12 h), 255 plasma samples (ideally 0, 1, 2, 3.5 and 5 h post-dose), aciclovir and 9-CMMG by UPLC-MS/MS. Median (IQR) age 56.0 (35.5-61.5) years, weight 69.5 (60.5-84.3) kg, serum creatinine 67.5 (53.4-90) umol/L, CKD-EPI eGFR 104 (83.8-122.5) mL/min/1.73 m2 (Table 1). Oral valaciclovir only.
- Final estimates (Table 2): aciclovir Tlag 0.3 h (fixed), ka 1.19 h-1, V/F 751.19 L, CL/F 19.87 L/h, beta CL/F [log(eGFR)] 2.86; 9-CMMG CL 234.71 L/h, beta CL [log(eGFR)] 0.62, Kp 0.1 h-1.
- Covariate model: Monolix log-transformed covariate centred on the median, CL/F = 19.87 x (eGFR/104)^2.86 and CL(9-CMMG) = 234.71 x (eGFR/104)^0.62. Other Monolix codings were tested against Tables 3-5 (exponential on the untransformed covariate, linear on a normally distributed parameter, power on log(eGFR), uncentred power); none reproduced the published simulations, whereas the centred power model does with the structure below.
- **Ambiguity (structure):** the article does not describe the parent-metabolite structure; Kp (0.1 h-1) is called a "tissue partition coefficient" but has the unit of a rate constant, and no formation fraction or metabolite volume is reported. **Choice:** Kp is the first-order rate constant of formation of 9-CMMG from the amount of aciclovir in the central compartment (formation clearance Kp x V/F = 75 L/h, an elimination pathway of aciclovir in addition to CL/F), and 9-CMMG is eliminated with CL(9-CMMG). With this structure the metabolic ratio AUC(9-CMMG)/AUC(aciclovir) = Kp x V/CL(9-CMMG) = 0.30 at eGFR 104 (Table 5: 30.4% for eGFR > 90), and the median simulated AUC0-24 for 2000 mg every 8 h by eGFR class (> 90, 61-90, 31-60, < 30) are 51, 68, 75 and 79 mg.h/L for aciclovir (Table 3: 44.8, 64.7, 63.6, 88.7) and 15, 26, 36 and 73 mg.h/L for 9-CMMG (13.3, 23.2, 37.7, 103.1); the < 30 class contains a single patient. Without the Kp pathway, the aciclovir AUC would be about 6 times higher and its eGFR dependence 60-fold steeper than in Table 3.
- **Ambiguity:** the volume of 9-CMMG is not reported. **Choice:** same apparent volume as aciclovir (751.19 L). With the Table 2 variability, the median steady-state Cmin for eGFR > 90 are 1.22 / 0.52 mg/L (aciclovir / 9-CMMG) with 2000 mg every 8 h and 0.57 / 0.27 mg/L every 12 h (Table 4: 1.0 / 0.5 and 0.4 / 0.2); a smaller volume (100 L) gives 0.40 / 0.18 mg/L for 9-CMMG.
- Dose: `amt` in mg of valaciclovir, without conversion (F = 1 in the model; the reported CL/F and V/F are apparent, "based on F = 54%"). With this coding, the model reproduces the AUC and Cmin of Tables 3-4 (AUC0-24 = dose / (CL/F + Kp x V/F) at steady state); the doses are not converted to aciclovir equivalents.
- eGFR: 2009 CKD-EPI creatinine equation indexed to BSA (mL/min/1.73 m2), computed in the model from SCR (umol/L / 88.4), AGE and SEX: 141 x min(SCr/k, 1)^a x max(SCr/k, 1)^-1.209 x 0.993^age x 1.018 if female x 1.159 if black (k 0.7/0.9, a -0.329/-0.411); the race coefficient is kept as a covariate (BLACK, default 0). eGFR is captured.
- Default covariates: medians of Table 1: AGE 56 years, SCR 67.5 umol/L, SEX 1 (29 men/21 women); they give an eGFR of 100 mL/min/1.73 m2 (reference 104).
- IIV: Monolix SDs (Table 2), squared: ka 1.0404 (SD 1.02), V/F 0.1521 (0.39), CL/F 0.7569 (0.87), CL(9-CMMG) 0.6241 (0.79), Kp 0.3364 (0.58), correlation CL(9-CMMG)-Kp 0.55 (covariance 0.252). The column "coefficient of variation (%)" of Table 2 (22.1, 14.7, 33.2, 13.5, 16.6) is read as the RSE of the SDs.
- Residual error: aciclovir proportional, b = 0.35 (variance 0.1225); 9-CMMG combined, a = 0.035 mg/L (variance 0.001225) and b = 0.24 (variance 0.0576). Aciclovir (cmt 2) and 9-CMMG (cmt 3) are captured as `PAR` and `MET`.
- Toxicity thresholds used by the authors: Cmin > 4.0 mg/L (aciclovir) and > 2.6 mg/L (9-CMMG).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(mrgsolve)
library(mapbayr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r model}
code <- '
[PROB]
Kably et al. 2025 - aciclovir and 9-CMMG after oral valaciclovir in early liver transplant recipients
(50 patients, 255 samples, joint parent-metabolite model, Monolix 2023R1 SAEM). Aciclovir: one-compartment model, lag time,
first-order absorption, apparent parameters, elimination by CL/F (CKD-EPI eGFR, power) and by formation of 9-CMMG (Kp).
9-CMMG: one compartment (volume of aciclovir assumed), CL with eGFR (power). IIV on ka, V/F, CL/F, CL(9-CMMG) and Kp
(correlated). Proportional (aciclovir) and combined (9-CMMG) residual errors.

[SET] end = 24, delta = 0.1

[PARAM] @annotated
TVCL     : 19.87  : Apparent clearance CL/F of aciclovir for eGFR 104 mL/min/1.73 m2 (L/h)
TH_GFR   : 2.86   : Exponent of eGFR on CL/F
EGFR_REF : 104    : Reference eGFR, median (mL/min/1.73 m2)
TVV      : 751.19 : Apparent volume of distribution V/F (L)
TVKA     : 1.19   : Absorption rate constant (1/h)
TLAG     : 0.3    : Lag time, fixed (h)
TVKP     : 0.1    : Rate constant of formation of 9-CMMG from aciclovir (1/h) (ambiguous, see Notes)
TVCLM    : 234.71 : Apparent clearance of 9-CMMG for eGFR 104 (L/h)
TH_GFRM  : 0.62   : Exponent of eGFR on CL(9-CMMG)
ETA1     : 0      : IIV KA
ETA2     : 0      : IIV V/F
ETA3     : 0      : IIV CL/F
ETA4     : 0      : IIV CL(9-CMMG)
ETA5     : 0      : IIV Kp

[PARAM] @annotated @covariates
AGE   : 56   : Age (years)
SCR   : 67.5 : Serum creatinine (umol/L)
SEX   : 1    : Sex (1 = male, 0 = female)
BLACK : 0    : Black race for CKD-EPI (1 = yes, 0 = no)

[CMT] @annotated
DEPOT : Depot, valaciclovir dose (mg) [ADM]
CENT  : Central compartment, aciclovir (mg) [OBS]
CMMG  : 9-CMMG compartment (mg aciclovir equivalents) [OBS]

[MAIN]
double KAP   = (SEX == 0) ? 0.7 : 0.9;
double ALPHA = (SEX == 0) ? -0.329 : -0.411;
double SCRK  = SCR / 88.4 / KAP;
double EGFR  = 141 * pow(SCRK < 1 ? SCRK : 1, ALPHA) * pow(SCRK > 1 ? SCRK : 1, -1.209) * pow(0.993, AGE) *
               (SEX == 0 ? 1.018 : 1.0) * (BLACK == 1 ? 1.159 : 1.0);
double KA  = TVKA * exp(ETA1 + ETA(1));
double V   = TVV * exp(ETA2 + ETA(2));
double CL  = TVCL * pow(EGFR / EGFR_REF, TH_GFR) * exp(ETA3 + ETA(3));
double CLM = TVCLM * pow(EGFR / EGFR_REF, TH_GFRM) * exp(ETA4 + ETA(4));
double KP  = TVKP * exp(ETA5 + ETA(5));
ALAG_DEPOT = TLAG;

[ODE]
dxdt_DEPOT = -KA * DEPOT;
dxdt_CENT  =  KA * DEPOT - CL / V * CENT - KP * CENT;
dxdt_CMMG  =  KP * CENT - CLM / V * CMMG;

[OMEGA] @annotated
EKA : 1.0404 : IIV KA (variance, SD 1.02)
EV  : 0.1521 : IIV V/F (variance, SD 0.39)
ECL : 0.7569 : IIV CL/F (variance, SD 0.87)

[OMEGA] @annotated @block
ECLM : 0.6241       : IIV CL(9-CMMG) (variance, SD 0.79)
EKP  : 0.2520 0.3364 : IIV Kp (variance, SD 0.58), covariance with CL(9-CMMG) (correlation 0.55)

[SIGMA] @annotated
PROP_A : 0.1225   : Proportional error, aciclovir (variance, b = 0.35)
ADD_A  : 0        : Additive error, aciclovir, not estimated
PROP_M : 0.0576   : Proportional error, 9-CMMG (variance, b = 0.24)
ADD_M  : 0.001225 : Additive error, 9-CMMG (variance, a = 0.035 mg/L)

[TABLE]
double PAR = CENT / V;
double MET = CMMG / V;
double DV = PAR * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2);
if (self.cmt == 3) DV = MET * (1 + EPS(3)) + EPS(4);
int i = 0;
while (DV < 0 && i < 100) {
  simeps();
  DV = PAR * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2);
  if (self.cmt == 3) DV = MET * (1 + EPS(3)) + EPS(4);
  ++i;
}

[CAPTURE] @annotated
DV   : Concentration, aciclovir or 9-CMMG according to cmt (mg/L)
PAR  : Aciclovir plasma concentration (mg/L)
MET  : 9-CMMG plasma concentration (mg/L, as aciclovir mass)
EGFR : Estimated GFR, CKD-EPI 2009 (mL/min/1.73 m2)
CL   : Individual apparent clearance CL/F of aciclovir (L/h)
CLM  : Individual apparent clearance of 9-CMMG (L/h)
KP   : Individual formation rate constant of 9-CMMG (1/h)
'
mod <- mcode("VACV_Kably", code)
```

```{r simulation}
# Typical 56-year-old men with eGFR about 110, 75, 45 and 20 mL/min/1.73 m2 (SCR 60, 92, 150 and 300 umol/L),
# valaciclovir 2000 mg every 8 h, day 10 (Tables 3-5: medians of 1000 simulated patients per regimen)
data <- data.frame(ID = 1:4, time = 0, evid = 1, cmt = 1, amt = 2000, ii = 8, addl = 29, SCR = c(60, 92, 150, 300))

out <- mod %>%
  zero_re() %>%
  data_set(data) %>%
  mrgsim(end = 240, delta = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(time >= 216)

# Article (2000 mg q8h, eGFR > 90 / 61-90 / 31-60 / < 30): AUC0-24 aciclovir 44.8 / 64.7 / 63.6 / 88.7, 9-CMMG 13.3 / 23.2 / 37.7 / 103.1 mg.h/L;
# metabolic ratio 30.4 / 34.9 / 47.6 / 129.9 %; Cmin aciclovir 1.0 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 3.7 and 9-CMMG 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.3 / 3.8 mg/L
out %>% group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(EGFR = EGFR[1],
            AUC24_ACV = sum(diff(time) * (head(PAR, -1) + tail(PAR, -1)) / 2),
            AUC24_CMMG = sum(diff(time) * (head(MET, -1) + tail(MET, -1)) / 2),
            Ratio_pct = 100 * AUC24_CMMG / AUC24_ACV,
            Cmin_ACV = min(PAR[time > 232]), Cmin_CMMG = min(MET[time > 232]))

ggplot(out %>% filter(time >= 232), aes(time - 232)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = PAR, colour = factor(round(EGFR)))) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MET, colour = factor(round(EGFR))), linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Time after dose (h)", y = "Concentration (mg/L)", colour = "eGFR",
       title = "Kably et al. 2025 - valaciclovir 2000 mg q8h: aciclovir (solid) and 9-CMMG (dashed)")
```
